title: Voice of the guest
headline: Every review, in every language, turned into actions and a heatmap by hotel.
context: Quality team at Brisa Hotels & Resorts, a leisure and urban hotel chain with hotels in Spain and the Caribbean. Reviews come from Google, Booking, TripAdvisor and the post-stay survey, in several languages.

accion.instructions: What should the quality team do with this review?

criteria.escalar: Escalate to management now: risk to health, safety or reputation (food poisoning, bed bugs, accident, discrimination, threat of a formal complaint or of going public).
criteria.responder: Respond: specific complaint or bad experience that requires a reply from the quality team.
criteria.agradecer: Thank: positive or mostly positive review.
criteria.archivar: Archive: neutral or generic review, nothing to handle.

sentimiento.instructions: What is the guest's overall sentiment?

limpieza.instructions: How does the guest rate the cleanliness?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

habitacion.instructions: How does the guest rate the room (comfort, size, condition, noise, beds)?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

comida.instructions: How does the guest rate the food and drink?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

personal.instructions: How does the guest rate the staff and service (attitude, front desk and check-in, speed, attentiveness)?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

instalaciones.instructions: How does the guest rate the facilities and shared amenities (pools, spa, lounge chairs, wifi, common areas)?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

ubicacion.instructions: How does the guest rate the location and surroundings?

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

precio.instructions: How does the guest rate the value for money? If they don't talk about prices or about what they paid, the answer is sin_mencion.

criteria.neutro: Mentions it without clearly rating it.

elogia_empleado.instructions: Does the guest expressly praise any employee or team at the hotel (by name or by role)?

items.text: Spotless room with a sea view. Best of all, Lucía at the front desk: she got us a table at the restaurant on our anniversary. We'll be back.
Everything fine. Pool good, food average, nothing special.
The balcony railing in room 412 is loose. My 5-year-old son leaned on it and almost fell. We reported it and it was still the same when we left.
I got food poisoning from the fish at the dinner buffet and ended up in the ER. Nobody from the hotel has checked on me. I'm going to file a complaint.
A security guard treated my husband in a racist way at the entrance to the beach club. Unacceptable. I want an explanation in writing.
Sky-high price for what it offers: watered-down drinks, lounge chairs taken from 7 in the morning and a spa you have to pay extra for.
Thanks to Andrés, our butler, the honeymoon was perfect. Every night there was a new special touch in the room. We'll be back!

notes.reto: Thousands of reviews a month in 5 languages and 5 platforms. Today they are read late and by sampling: serious incidents (bed bugs, food poisoning, safety) are detected when they have already gone viral.
notes.solucion: A single call per review answers 10 questions: action, sentiment, rating of 7 aspects and whether it praises an employee. The result feeds a heatmap by hotel and an alert queue.
notes.paradigma: Decision-1 does the screening (System 1) and an LLM only drafts the replies that are needed (System 2). 100% of reviews are analyzed, not a sample, and LLM spend drops to a fraction.
aplica_a: Quality by hotel and by aspect
